answer: A sybil swarm is throttled when speaking costs capital that only real operators can lose repeatedly. Make each identity post a bond refundable only after a long horizon of honest participation; every third-party report it files draws on that bond, and slashing burns it instead of recycling it. Stick a cedar tag, a signed thread of past votes, into each dossier, so peers can trace history and spot clones minted in one batch. Splitting a wallet into a thousand voices buys a thousand liabilities, and the attacker pays the whole bill.
